evaluation_separation: references.json is scoring-only. Runtime detection must use actual source text, operational sensitivity_policy, and local rules; it must not load references or treat empty privacy_spans as gold negatives.
expected_scope: Qoder to Harness through a trusted host; EMAIL pseudonymization and separate finite export rights. No arbitrary semantic categories, hostile host, native static-client ACL, or online forgetting guarantee.
note: New material was authored by an AI assistant for this project; unreviewed synthetic controls cannot substitute for expert annotation or representative security benchmarks.
shared_grammar: All stories use bounded explicit field-value sentences, even though narrative layouts/template-family names differ across development/check. This is not a claim of unseen natural-language template generalization.
units: Story is the independent analysis unit. Multiple facts, task questions, methods, and repeated calls within one story are correlated.
